title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Job Duties: Design, build, and maintain scalable ML infrastructure to support notification relevance, targeting, ranking, and personalization across channels (e.g. push, email, in-app notifications) for millions of users. Architect and implement end-to-end ML pipelines for notifications, including data ingestion, feature computation, model training, evaluation, deployment, and online serving in production environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and engineers across teams to define requirements, align on priorities, and deliver end-to-end notification solutions. Lead design and implementation of experimentation frameworks (e.g. A/B testing, multi-armed bandits, or similar methods) to evaluate new notification models, ranking strategies, and targeting policies. Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, sharing best practices in machine learning engineering, distributed systems, and ML infrastructure design. Full-time telecommuting is an option.

Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering (any field) or related quantitative discipline and five (5) years of experience in the job offered or related occupation.  

Special Skill Requirements: (1) designing, building, and iterating large-scale scalable software systems; (2) designing and building ML recommender systems at high scale; (3) Delivering large and complex systems with significant business impact; (4) Cross-functional collaboration on large-scale projects with complex dependencies across teams; (5) Object-oriented programming (Python, Golang, or Java); (6) Building ML models with PyTorch or TensorFlow; (7) API design and integration with REST, HTTP, Thrift, or gRPC; (8) Working with largescale key-value and NoSQL storage and caching systems (Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB); (9) Working with large-scale messaging and event-driven systems (Apache Kafka, AWS SQS, SNS, SES ); (10) Building workflows using orchestration systems (Kubeflow, Ray, Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions); (11) Working with large-scale analytics and data warehousing platforms (Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift); (12) Experience with observability, logging, tracing and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS Cloudwatch; (13) Designing, running, and analyzing A/B experiments to measure and optimize system performance

title: Senior Credit Disputes Specialist
description:
About Upstart

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:
Upstart ’s Credit Dispute and Reporting team is responsible for managing and resolving customer disputes related to credit reporting, ensuring accuracy and integrity of credit information, and adhering to regulatory requirements. The credit dispute and reporting team play a vital role in maintaining accurate credit records, resolving disputes efficiently, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
As a Senior Credit Disputes Specialist at Upstart , you will be responsible for handling the credit dispute functions including indirect disputes through e-Oscar, responding to direct disputes in Salesforce, and understanding the credit information that is being reported to the credit reporting agencies month over month. You will be required to make efficient use of the company resources and technical capabilities to properly investigate account information and provide accurate credit report information to the major credit bureaus.
How you’ll make an impact

• Handling the credit dispute functions and ensures using company resources to properly investigate all account information to provide accurate credit information is being reported.

• Act as a liaison between consumer reporting agencies, E-Oscar, and Upstart resolving credit bureau related issues and assisting with customer inquiries.

• Ensuring information is reported accurately and is processed promptly whether it is a direct or indirect credit dispute.

• Ensuring compliance with FCRA in researching and responding to credit disputes, maintaining service levels, and updating account status as necessary.

Minimum Qualifications

• 1-2 years experience working on credit bureau reporting at a Financial Institution.

• Credit dispute resolution experience with in-depth knowledge and familiarity with the credit reporting agencies.

• In depth knowledge and experience working with e-Oscar.

• Familiarity with the Metro2 format and reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong understanding of key credit reporting laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA).

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience working in credit dispute resolution, handling a wide range of dispute types.

• Experience reviewing complex credit files, transaction histories, to assist in identifying errors or inconsistencies.

• High School Diploma and/or GED or relevant equivalent experience

title: Data Engineer, Application Software
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Machine Learning team within Application Software, part of Product & Delivery, works on critical initiatives that push the frontier of model-based autonomous driving. That covers core driving performance as well as feature-level intelligence such as personalisation, comfort and collaboration.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Data Engineer, you’ll design and deliver scalable data pipelines that turn vast amounts of data from diverse internal and external sources into structured, reliable and model-ready datasets. Your work spans data ingestion, data quality assurance, transformation, curation, evaluation and ML support. You’ll work closely with Wayve’s Data Corpus teams, customer programmes and ML engineers, bringing up ingestion pipelines for new vehicle platforms and sensor configurations, and tackling the highest-impact bottlenecks first.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

- Building and improving scalable data pipelines that support model development, evaluation and production ML workflows for autonomous driving.

- Ingesting, transforming and curating large-scale real-world, synthetic and partner-provided datasets into structured, reliable, model-ready formats aligned with standardised taxonomies and coordinate systems.

- Developing data quality checks, validation processes and monitoring so that raw vehicle data and processed datasets are high-quality, complete, consistent, traceable and fit for ML use cases.

- Curating and mining real-world and synthetic data to drive scenario diversity, coverage and feature-specific development.

- Improving pipeline performance, reliability and usability, reducing bottlenecks and increasing iteration velocity across ML development.

- Collaborating closely with ML engineers, Data Corpus, AI Platform and external partners so data pipelines integrate effectively with production-scale learning systems.

🙌 You should apply if:

Essential

- Proven experience building and operating scalable data pipelines or distributed data processing systems in production environments.

- Strong software engineering skills in Python, with a solid foundation in maintainable, reliable, and well-tested software development practices.

- Proficient in SQL and PySpark, with experience using warehouse/OLAP concepts, window functions, and Spark for distributed data processing.

- Experience with modern data pipeline architectures, including workflow orchestration and DAG-based systems such as Airflow, Flyte, Ray, or similar.

- Solid understanding of robotics and automated driving data concepts, including sensor characteristics, timestamping and clock synchronisation, coordinate transformations, calibration, and ego-motion signals such as GNSS/IMU and vehicle odometry.

- Understanding of machine learning development workflows, including training data generation, evaluation datasets, scenario mining, and model iteration.

- Excellent communication and collaborative skills, capable of working effectively with interdisciplinary teams.

Desirable

- Prior work in calibration, perception, imitation learning, or trajectory prediction.

- Experience with third-party dataset ingestion and transformation.

- Familiarity with automated driving data and scenario taxonomies, including ODD definitions, manoeuvre and behavior labels, scene classification, event tagging, semantic understanding.

title: Senior Strategic Growth Partner
description:
The Role
This is a senior client-facing role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of strategy, growth, sales, and execution.
You will work directly with founders and business owners, understand their business in depth, identify what is holding growth back, and help them decide what to do next.
You are not here to simply manage a relationship.
You are here to become a trusted partner in the growth of the business.
That means understanding the client's goals, offer, market, acquisition strategy, sales process, delivery model, current constraints, and commercial priorities - then helping them turn that into a clear plan of action.
In some conversations, you will be helping a founder sharpen their positioning.
In others, you will be diagnosing why pipeline is weak, why sales are not converting, why execution is stalling, or where the next growth opportunity sits.
Your job is to create clarity. To tell clients what matters now. To show them what needs to happen next. And to make sure the right actions actually happen.
This is not a traditional Customer Success role.
It is a role for someone who wants to become an exceptional commercial operator by working closely with ambitious founders and helping them solve real business problems.
The Opportunity
You will have exposure to a large number of businesses, markets, offers, sales models, and growth challenges.
That creates an unusually steep learning curve.
Instead of spending years inside one company solving one set of problems, you will see patterns across dozens of businesses and develop the judgment to quickly understand:

• What is actually holding growth back

• What is noise and what matters

• Where the highest-leverage opportunity is

• What the founder should focus on now

• What should be stopped

• What should be doubled down on

• How strategy should translate into execution

Over time, the expectation is that clients see you as someone whose judgment they trust.
Someone who can walk into a complicated situation, understand it quickly, simplify it, and give them a clear direction forward.
If you want to build serious capability in growth strategy, founder communication, sales, operations, and commercial decision-making, this role gives you the environment to do it.
What You Will Own
Become a True Growth Partner to Clients
You will work closely with founders to understand the business beyond surface-level account updates.
You will build a clear picture of:

• Their business model

• Target market

• ICP

• Offer

• Pricing

• Positioning

• Acquisition channels

• Sales process

• Current pipeline

• Delivery model

• Team capacity

• Growth goals

• Immediate constraints

From there, you will help determine the highest-priority actions required to move the business forward.
Advise, Don't Just Support
We are not looking for someone who simply responds to questions.
We want someone capable of leading the thinking.
You should be comfortable saying:
"This is the problem I think we need to solve first."
"This is where I think you're focusing on the wrong thing."
"This is the strategy I would recommend."
"This is what I would do over the next 30 days."
"This is what needs to happen before we scale."
You will challenge clients when needed, simplify decisions, and help them avoid wasting time on low-leverage work.
Your value comes from your judgment, not just your responsiveness.
Turn Strategy Into Action
Good advice without execution is useless.
Every strategic conversation should translate into clear priorities.
You will help clients move from broad goals to focused execution:

• Define the objective

• Identify the constraint

• Decide the strategy

• Break it into clear actions

• Assign ownership

• Set timelines

• Review what happened

• Adjust based on results

You should naturally reduce complexity rather than add to it.
If a client has fifteen things they could be doing, your job is often to help them identify the two or three that actually matter.

Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

Poland is one of the biggest markets in the Hedepy portfolio, and one of the most competitive. Your goal will be to grow our market share and significantly raise awareness of Hedepy in the Polish mental health space, so that support reaches the people who need it.
You'll report directly to Caro, our Local CMO for PL/GR/LT/SI, and run the Polish market together with her. You'll also be part of an international marketing team of 15 people.
What you'll do
Influencers and social media (50%)
You'll oversee influencer and social media activities and production, and manage offline events such as PR stunts and brand activations.
Localising acquisition marketing (30%)
You'll take what we run across markets and make it land in Poland: ad assets, landing page copy, mailings, SEO and ad headlines. This is localisation, not translation, so it should read as if it was written for a Polish audience from the start.
Data and strategy (20%)
You'll read the dashboards, understand why a campaign works or stalls, run tests across channels, and turn all of that into a clear point of view. We care most about the long game: user acquisition, share of search, CPA, and whether the brand is actually growing.
Across all three, you'll shape a strategy that fits the Polish market, informed by what works in the category and for our competitors.
What you'll own
After a trial period, the decisions are yours. You'll own content localisation, influencer collaborations, local partnerships and awareness activities, without needing to check with the CMO first.
Requirements
What you bring

•
Experience: at least 3 years in a similar role.

•
Social media: hands-on experience running and optimising channels such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube. Please share examples.

•
Influencer collaborations: you've coordinated them end to end, from research and creator selection through negotiating terms and contracts to execution and a wrap-up with learnings.

•
Language: you'll be translating content into Polish and adapting it for a Polish audience, so writing has to be one of your strengths.

•
Mental health and empathy: a genuine interest in mental health, whether through education or personal experience, and an empathetic personality.

•
Mindset: strategic, curious and insightful, not afraid to dig deep into data, and open to testing new solutions.

Nice to have

• Experience with influencer collaborations for SaaS products or apps.

• Experience with UX optimisation on websites. Please share examples.

Benefits
What we offer

• Remote-first culture, so you can work from anywhere

• 2 free therapy sessions per month through the Hedepy platform :)

• An international team with colleagues from 10 different countries

• Company-wide offsites and workations by the sea 🫶

AI? Yes, but wisely

• We support using AI. Use it to help you, but keep a human filter. We say no to applications written entirely by AI (yes, we can tell). We want to get to know you, not Claude or Gemini.
Sound like you?
Send us your CV along with a few examples of your work: social media channels you've run, influencer collaborations you've led, and, if you have them, website UX optimisations. A few lines on why mental health matters to you are very welcome too.
We're looking forward to meeting you!
- The Hedepy B2C Marketing team 🤗

title: Staff Robotics Engineer, Localization
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define and evolve the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s onboard localisation capability, aligned with vehicle programmes and product requirements.

- Lead the development of robust state-estimation systems that fuse GNSS, IMU and wheel-odometry signals, with scope to incorporate camera-, RADAR- and LiDAR-based measurements.

- Take localisation solutions from algorithm design and prototyping through production implementation and deployment on real-time vehicle platforms, including robust fault handling and degraded-mode behaviour.

- Develop rigorous validation and benchmarking capabilities, including representative datasets, ground-truth comparisons, performance metrics and regression testing across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions.

- Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship, working across robotics, calibration, controls, sensors and vehicle-platform teams to drive integration and resolve complex system-level issues.

Leading the technical development of our onboard localisation capability. You will design and productionise state-estimation systems that combine GNSS, IMU and wheel odometry to provide accurate, reliable vehicle motion and pose estimates across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for shaping the localisation architecture and technical roadmap, while remaining deeply involved in algorithm development, implementation, validation and onboard deployment. You will work across robotics, calibration, controls, sensor, vehicle-platform and embedded-software teams to ensure localisation is robust, observable and suitable for real-time production use. You will also provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers working across localisation and the broader state-estimation stack.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Essential

- Deep practical expertise in localisation, state estimation or sensor fusion, with experience combining GNSS, IMU and wheel-odometry measurements.

- Strong understanding of filtering-based estimation methods, including Kalman-family filters such as the EKF or UKF, and nonlinear optimisation approaches such as factor graphs.

- Experience developing and operating localisation or state-estimation systems in production robotics, autonomous vehicles or comparable real-time systems.

- Strong modern C++ software-engineering skills and proficiency in Python for prototyping, analysis, validation and test tooling.

- Experience designing rigorous localisation validation and benchmarking, including accuracy metrics, uncertainty evaluation, ground-truth comparison, regression testing and failure analysis.

- Evidence of hands-on technical leadership, including defining architecture, influencing technical roadmaps, mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively across multiple teams.

Desirable

- Experience incorporating camera-, LiDAR- or RADAR-based measurements into localisation and sensor-fusion systems, including visual, LiDAR or RADAR odometry.

- Hands-on experience with nonlinear optimisation and robotics l

title: Agile Delivery Manager
description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Salary: £75,000 - £90,000 DOE
Location: Fully remote
Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.
About the role
TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.
You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.
Responsibilities
Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

• Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.

• Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.

• Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.

• Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.
Agile Delivery Management

• Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.

• Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.

• Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.

• Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.
Lightweight Governance & Reporting

• Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.

• Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.

• Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.

• Help define and mature TwinStream ’s delivery governance model - ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.
Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

• Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.

• Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.

• Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.

• Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

• Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.

• Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience - technical or non-technical.

• Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.

• Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.
Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

• Contribute to improving TwinStream ’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.

• Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.

• Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.
Key Skills

• Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams

title: Supply Chain AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from supply chain, in sectors such as CPG, retail, manufacturing or pharma, who build demand, inventory and capacity plans in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a Supply Chain Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in supply chain, demand planning, procurement or operations, in sectors such as CPG, retail, manufacturing, pharma or logistics

- Deep hands-on Excel: inventory and demand planning, Solver, data reshaping, multi-criteria lookups and debugging

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Traditional PR is fading - we go directly to our audience. This role brings together what used to be two separate seats, communications and social media, into one mid-to-senior, hands-on role: owning Supabase's voice in the channels where developers actually pay attention, and building our founders' presence in them.

"New media" here means modern and direct, not traditional press - we care far more about getting our founders onto the right podcasts and YouTube channels than landing a New York Times placement. It's part comms, part social operator, with a sharper edge than a typical polite PR hire: someone willing to put an opinion out there and push a little rather than always play it safe. But it's not just a social media job either - this person also needs the poise and technical credibility to lead comms through genuinely high-stakes moments, like a major incident, where reporters, investors, and customers all need a calm, credible, technically fluent voice at the same time.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Make sure we're part of the current conversation and are going directly to our audience - new media over old-world press

- Own and execute our new media strategy

- Run and grow Supabase's X + LinkedIn accounts, hands on keyboard

- Help build the accounts of our founders and team - including ghostwriting in their voice

- Explore and exploit unconventional channels and formats

- Book our cofounders on the most known shows, podcasts, and YouTube channels in our space

- Work directly with DevRel and the PMM team on launches and Select

- Track record of growing accounts, ideally for a technical audience

- Unconventional thinker - willing to put an opinion out there and push a little, with the judgment to know when

- Seasoned enough for the serious moments - incidents, funding, press - calm, credible, and technically fluent

- High agency - you're probably already doing a version of this somewhere scrappier

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

title: Scientific Product Manager
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

YOUR IMPACT

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS & ROADMAP

- Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

- Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

- Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

PARTNER LAB ONBOARDING

- Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

- Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

- Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

CLOSED-LOOP CAMPAIGNS

title: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)
description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.
As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.
The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.
Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.
Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.
Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.
Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.
2. Group P&L & Financial Performance
Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.
Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.
Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.
Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.
Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.
3. Financial Planning & Performance Management
Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.
Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.
Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.
Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.
Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.
4. Insurance Finance
Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.
Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.
Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.
Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.
Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.
5. Investment & Asset Management Finance
Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.
Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.
Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.
Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.
Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.
6. Group Capital & Solvency Management
Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.
Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.
Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.
Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Infra - SF
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers lead complex deployments of frontier models in production. You will embed with customers where model performance matters, delivery is urgent, and ambiguity is the default. You will use this to map their problems, structure delivery, and ship fast. 

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for AI Infra, you will work directly with customer engineers, researchers and product engineers on optimization problems across semiconductors and AI infrastructure. You will write and debug software, run experiments against real workloads and hardware, and improve the tools and product used across engagements.

You will help define the problem and success criteria, build the software needed to test an approach, and stay with the work through validation and deployment. Work may include inference performance and chip-design optimization. Success means producing results that stand up to correctness and performance checks, and contributing improvements that other engagements can use.

Success in this role means owning the delivery state across workstreams. You will hold the bar on quality and pace and help OpenAI learn through execution.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role, you will:

- Own technical delivery for agreed semiconductor and AI-infrastructure workstreams, from initial scoping and prototypes through validation, production deployment and adoption.

- Work closely with customer engineers to understand their workflows and constraints, define workloads, baselines and success criteria, and help what you build become part of how they work.

- Scope and sequence delivery, identify dependencies and blockers early, and make practical trade-offs between scope, speed and quality as the work develops.

- Personally build and debug production-quality software, including harnesses, integrations and product features that apply frontier models to problems in chip design, verification, inference and performance engineering.

- Design reproducible experiments, evaluations, graders and benchmarks to test approaches, validate correctness and performance, and establish whether improvements hold up in real engineering environments.

- Investigate model behavior and failure modes alongside researchers, contributing evaluation or training data and targeted experiments where they can improve the underlying capability.

- Contribute directly to core product development, working with product engineers to resolve tooling gaps, ship useful improvements and bring field learning into product decisions.

- Lead technical discussions and maintain alignment across customer, Product and Research teams. Build the domain and product fluency to explain capabilities, limitations and results, and keep ownership, risks and next steps clear.

- Turn successful approaches into reusable software, tools and playbooks, reducing the effort needed for future engagements and helping customer teams operate what has been built.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

- Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

- Write and review production-grade software, and debug unfamiliar systems across code, integrations and runtime behavior.

- Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

- Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

- Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

- Spot risks early and adjust without slowing

title: Lead Climate Action Coordinator
description:
Launch your Sustainability Career with the Climate Corps Fellowship program!

SEI’s Climate Corps Fellowship program offers the chance to lead impactful climate and community resilience projects while gaining paid, hands-on experience. This full-time, bridge-to-career opportunity pairs fellows with host organizations, from local governments to nonprofits and businesses, to drive real-world change.

About the Opportunity
Start Date: November 16th, 2026
Length of Fellowship: 8 months
Location Type: Remote (Within California)
Are you passionate about tackling climate challenges, communicating sustainability solutions, and supporting statewide climate action? As a Climate Action Program Coordinator in the Climate Corps Fellowship program, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful sustainability initiatives with the California Community Colleges Chancellor’s Office. This is a remote position within California, with the expectation of regular travel to colleges and universities as needed.
In this role, you’ll support the advancement of Vision 2030 by working directly with the California Community Colleges Chancellor’s Office Climate Action Team and partnering with colleges across the system to implement and communicate climate action and sustainability initiatives. Working at the intersection of climate resilience, higher education, communications, and institutional transformation, the Fellow will support statewide climate programs through program coordination, technical assistance, stakeholder engagement, communications, public relations, social media, administrative support, and development of resources that advance climate action across California’s community colleges.
The Fellow will also provide technical assistance to colleges completing the AASHE STARS sustainability assessment and reporting framework, helping campuses measure progress, identify opportunities for improvement, and communicate their sustainability accomplishments. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the nation’s largest systems of higher education while gaining hands-on experience in climate program implementation, sustainability reporting, communications, stakeholder engagement, project coordination, and statewide climate action.
About Our Partner: California Community College Chancellor's Office
California Community College Chancellor's Office is the administrative headquarters for the country's largest higher education system. With 116 colleges and 2.2 million students, the California Community Colleges seek to educate students from all backgrounds and with all educational goals, from transfer to workforce development. Under Vision 2030, the 116 colleges have been asked to lead the way in climate action, including with curriculum integration, workforce development for climate-ready careers, sustainable facilities and operations, and community engagement with climate partners.
What You’ll Do

• Support Climate Action Team Programs and Initiatives: Provide programmatic and administrative support to the Chancellor’s Office Climate Action Team, helping coordinate statewide initiatives, projects, partnerships, meetings, timelines, deliverables, and follow-up activities.

• Advance Vision 2030 Climate Initiatives: Assist in implementing statewide climate action priorities that support Vision 2030, with a focus on climate resilience, sustainability, equity, workforce development, institutional transformation, and community engagement across the California Community Colleges system.

• Support AASHE STARS Implementation: Provide technical assistance to assigned California Community Colleges completing the AASHE STARS assessment, including data collection, documentation, reporting, coordination, and identification of opportunities for continuous improvement.

title: CRM Manager B2C
description:
CRM Manager B2C

About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What you’ll be doing

As our CRM Manager, you’ll be the person who builds and improves the automated journeys that keep our customers engaged and coming back.

You’ll join our B2C CRM team and take care of the customer lifecycle: automated customer journeys, retention campaigns and conversion rate optimization, rather than one-off campaigns. You’ll work mainly with Product Marketing, plus Product and Legal, to improve engagement, conversion and retention across our 6 million customers. You’ll start hands-on and, within your first months, grow into shaping the strategy. Over time, your focus may move to a specific product. You’ll report to the Lead of our B2C CRM team.

Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

- Strategy & impact on OKRs - Track how the products you follow are performing against their Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and design lifecycle and campaign strategies that move them. Join cross-team discussions to understand and influence decisions.

- Campaign and lifecycle setup - Build and run automated journeys (canvases) in our CRM tool, following the shared strategy across channels (email, in-app messages, push and more). That includes segmentation, personalization and creative development.

- Project management - Lead medium-complexity projects with other teams, mainly Product Marketing, plus Product, Legal and Data. Gather requirements, make sure our communications are compliant, and shape the solutions that bring them to life.

- Performance & KPIs - Define project KPIs and run A/B tests. After every launch, check the results on your own (open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, retention, ROI), then optimize and share insights that shape the next strategy.

- Continuous optimization - Review how we work today and propose improvements. Keep an eye on what competitors are doing and bring ideas and proposals to the team. Keep up with CRM platform releases and suggest ways to improve what we already have.

- AI-driven innovation and automation - Use AI to make campaigns and lifecycle programs more efficient, segmentation more accurate and ideation sharper. Find, propose and ship new ideas that scale the business and challenge the status quo.

Who we’re looking for

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in!
Does this sound like you?

- Experience & education - A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing (or a related field) and around 5 years of hands-on experience designing, managing and optimizing CRM campaigns and lifecycle programs, including automated customer journeys.

- Industry experience - A background in fintech, banking or insurance is preferred. Experience in large-scale retail or in digital B2C apps is also welcome.

- Technical skills - Solid expertise in CRM and marketing automation platforms, and the autonomy to build in them yourself. Knowing Braze is a plus, and experience with similar tools counts.

- Analytical mindset - Strong analytical skills. You look at the results of what you launch and optimize on your own, without being asked, using data to make decisions.

- Stakeholder management - You work well with different teams, gather requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions.

- Organization & autonomy - You are highly organized and work well both in a team and on your own.

- Proactivity & adaptability - You learn quickly, take initiative and adapt your approach as things change. You’re happy to be hands-on at the start and ready to take on strategy as you grow.

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT US

Reach Digital is an AI-first performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative, paid media, and landing pages. We are a true growth partner - going deep with brands to become integrated into their marketing team. We drive real growth by combining data, testing, and new ideas.

We're a fully remote team of creatives, editors, and growth strategists. We care about the work, and care about being the best at what we do.

THE ROLE

As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end-to-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have 2+ years of digital marketing experience

You understand paid media and the types of content that converts

You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life

You are detail-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously

You're willing to learn and get better even when that means giving and receiving feedback

You are comfortable communicating learnings with both team members and clients

You're genuinely passionate about creative strategy and staying on top of what's working -- you do this because you want to, not because you have to

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Analyzing performance, brainstorming ad angles and hook variations, and writing new briefs weekly for the editing team to produce

Owning the creative strategy for your brand partners, including a living strategy doc that tracks angles, performance, and what to test next

Staying current on platform trends, winning ad formats, and policy changes, and translating that into testable concepts for your accounts

Working with 3-5 brand partners at a time, with a focus on going deep into their creative and building new winning ads

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM US

Growth: We invest in the people who invest in the work. Expect regular creative reviews, direct feedback, and room to grow into senior roles as Reach scales.

Weekly Calls & Creative Training: Weekly team check-ins, creative reviews and training sessions. Calls are typically held between 12pm-6pm EST on weekdays.

Generous PTO and benefits policy

Fully remote role (working US hours)

Competitive compensation in USD

The Hiring Process

All candidates will go through a 15-minute questionnaire. Following this, top candidates will be given a culture fit interview before being given a paid, take-home assignment.

Salary: $18,000 - $33,000 / year Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Clinical Team Lead
description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

title: Enterprise Strategy Analyst
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Enterprise Strategy Analyst to join our team at Lightspeed. This role will support enterprise and business strategy efforts by conducting analysis, developing insights, and helping teams make data-driven decisions. As Lightspeed enters its next phase of growth and a multi-year transformation, this role will help shape and support key strategic priorities across the business. The ideal candidate brings strong strategic thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll be doing:

- Support enterprise and business strategy efforts through research, analysis, and insight development, including contributing to annual strategic planning and ongoing strategic review cadences

- Break down complex business problems and conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis

- Build models, synthesize data, and develop materials to support executive-level decision-making

- Contribute to the development of business cases, plans, and recommendations

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather inputs and support the execution of key initiatives

- Help track progress and performance of initiatives against key milestones and targets

What you need to bring:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

- Ability to structure problems and work through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

- Comfort working with data and translating findings into clear insights

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions

- Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and take ownership

- As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

- 1-5 years of experience in consulting, strategy, finance, or a related field

- Experience working on structured problem-solving engagements (e.g., strategy, operations, or transformation projects)

- Internship or early-career experience involving data analysis and business problem solving

- Experience in SaaS, fintech, or other technology-driven environments

You’ll enjoy:

- A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

- A culture that celebrates performance

- The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

- Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

- Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

- Equity options, because this is your company too

- Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

- Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

- Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

- Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

- Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

- Computer purchase program to get your personal MacBook

- Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $90,000 - $120,000 CAD. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

- Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

- Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

- Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.

HOW WE WORK

- Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

- Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

- Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

- AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?

WHAT YOU BRING

- 3-5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

- You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

- You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

- You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

- You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

- German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

- Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.

WHY US?

- Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.

- A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.

- Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

- Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

- Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

- A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

- Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

- Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

Cosuno - Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno - a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.
